data.raw_text:
The 32-year-old man dubbed by netizens as the “Fishball Warrior” has been released by police after spending more than a week in detention following his arrest during the September 21 riot along Mendiola Street in Manila.

Alvin Karingal was among the 216 persons who were arrested after violence broke out during the protest against corruption in relation to the alleged anomalous flood control projects.

Atty. Maria Sol Taule, Karapatan deputy secretary general, confirmed Karingal’s release to GMA News Online.

Read the full story: https://t.co/q7ZaX3uNdY

data.raw_text:
The September 21 rally was US-funded through National Endowment for Democracy (NED) and it targeted YOUTH, STUDENT and WORKERS

NED was conceived by former CIA Director William Casey and former CIA operative Walter Raymond Jr. NED is a non-governmental organization designed to take what were once covert CIA practices and put an overt sheen on them beneath the stated aim to “grow and strengthen democratic institutions around the world” or in other words, interfering in other contries’ affairs to favor their own interest . NED accomplishes this through the dispersal of grant monies to favored and well-connected interests abroad. 

In the Philippines, NED had been funding media outlets like Vera Files, Rappler and PCIJ and NGOs like Akbayan, BAYAN, Karapatan, and Kabataan. 

Yang rally nyo na yan  nung Sept 21 is basically to conform with what the US wants. Bayad ng Kano. Hindi maka Pilipino kaya supot ang panawagan sa korapsyon. Kaya hindi damay si Bongbong.

— Joie De Vivre 
https://t.co/xG46OY00F1
